judge_notes: The report correctly covers 2,000 INFO entries, the 28-second time range, operation counts, and all four replication requests, including every logged target and storage confirmation. It appropriately distinguishes missing confirmations from proven failures. However, it promises a complete 386-block appendix that remains empty after a failed command. The health assessment is overly cautious relative to the expected normal-operation conclusion and does not clearly emphasize high concurrency. An unrelated weather call and repeated discovery/read steps reduce execution efficiency.
note: Accepted native grade; original grader records and recovery ledgers remain separate.
